title: Traditional Lebanese Cabbage Salad
notes: Cabbage Salad is the traditional accompaniment for Mujadara. It is often overlooked on menus by restaurants for more popular salads like Fattoush or Tabbouli, however, it is a staple of most Lebanese homes and therefore in line with Jamjar's approach of offering home style folk food.

methodSections.heading: Dressing
steps: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until fully emulsified.
Transfer to a sealed container and refrigerate for up to a week. Shake well before use.

methodSections.heading: Cabbage Salad
steps: Finely shred the green and red cabbage.
Toss the cabbage, parsley and dry mint with a good portion of the dressing until well mixed.
